title: Dam overtopping
goal: Show flood outcomes through warning, spillway operation, and evacuation.

rubric.must: The initiating event Extreme inflow exceeds reservoir design level and its frequency are visible at the left.
Ordered function columns visibly show flood warning, emergency spillway, and evacuation.
Terminal branches visibly distinguish controlled-release and overtopping outcomes.
Each safety-function column visibly shows complementary success and failure branch probabilities.
Success and failure paths are visibly traceable from the initiator to terminal outcomes.
The left-to-right event-tree sequence remains legible without ambiguous crossings.
